name: RCA CTDPFA salinity calibration, Cabled-07 SKQ201610S (2016)

annotations.annotation: Due to errors during vendor calibration, a calibration offset (CC_offset) of 4.13 is being applied during the on-demand creation of the L1 Seawater Pressure (dbar) data product from this instrument. For more information please contact help@oceanobservatories.org.
Cause of data gap under investigation.

Data values are within plausible ranges, but lower than usual L0 conductivity values throughout the entire water column during this time period make the salinity, oxygen, and density products suspect.

rca:flags.text: 1 of 18 upcasts found in the profiler data do not match a profile in the official index.
Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (13106 scans, 12918 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.

Bottle salinity is taken from the cruise's discrete summary (the laboratory's Autosal and cast-log workbooks are not available for this cruise); replicates are averaged and the summary's flags are applied.
Niskin 1 (CTD-006 Niskin 1, ~220 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle +0.0066 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there -0.000 PSU/m.
Niskin 7 (CTD-006 Niskin 7, ~160 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle -0.0204 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.004 PSU/m.
Niskin 1 (CTD-006 Niskin 1, ~220 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle +0.0106 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there -0.001 PSU/m.
Niskin 7 (CTD-006 Niskin 7, ~160 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle -0.0135 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.004 PSU/m.
